prompt: Direction A, "Photostat": the title screen presented as an examiner's photostat negative of a 1950s US patent drawing. Deep blue-black ground with faint silver paper fibre; every line is cool white like light through a copy camera, with a slight halo bleed. A ruled sheet border; a narrow right margin holding a small circular dial with tick marks and two short arrows. In the lower half, the drawing: a tiny square runner standing on a long block filled with fine vertical hatching, a gap, then another block; a dash-dot phantom outline of the block shifted one step sideways; thin curved leader lines pointing at parts with blank tags at their ends. Toward the right, three tall door-shaped rectangles side by side, one hatched vertically, one diagonally, one horizontally. A single accent: one red pencil circle. Engraved, precise, quiet, generous dark negative space in the upper half. Only faint desaturated tints of red, green and blue inside the hatching.
